'''Jacob "Jake" Paque''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
As an adult, Paque became a voice actor and mostly got minor roles in the beginning. He usually provided his voice for English-dubbed versions of international shows. He first voiced [[Eric]] in ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]'' and formally joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} in the beginning of {{aniseries|XY}}. Paque's most prominent role in the [[Pokémon]] franchise is {{an|Professor Sycamore}}.
